prompt: A car uses $4$ gallons of gas to drive $120$ miles. How many **miles per gallon**?
hint: "Miles per gallon" asks how many miles the car gets out of each single gallon. Which number should be divided by which?

hints.text: "Miles per gallon" asks how many miles the car gets out of each single gallon. Which number should be divided by which?
The miles go first in "miles per gallon", so divide the $120$ miles by the $4$ gallons.
$120 \div 4 = 30$, so the car gets $30$ miles per gallon.

explanation: The word "per" means divide, and the unit named first (miles) is the number being divided.
Set up $\frac{120 \text{ miles}}{4 \text{ gallons}}$ so the answer will be miles for $1$ gallon.
Divide both parts by $4$ to get $120 \div 4 = 30$ miles for each gallon.
The car travels $30$ miles per gallon.
